_comment: Model families you can use. Per user: install.sh copies this file to families.json beside it
(untracked), with every family on. For a family you cannot use (no plan or subscription), set
{"active": false, "reason": "<why, with a date>"}. Inactive families are left out of tier
menus (route.py menu) and a plan roster tier on one makes route.py resolve exit 3 (ask);
a tier you name yourself still runs. A missing file or family counts as active.
Every launch still asks you for model + effort unless you name a tier or approve a plan roster.
